"Who are you lot?
Don't go barging into Lord Fulgrant's room uninvited."{w}

"Lord Fulgrant is asleep!
Come back another time!"{w}

"Hey, you're the ones helpin' out with Balgert's plan, right?{w}Won'tcha hear out our idea too?"{w}{p}"...Huh, me? I'm Fulgrant!
I'm the boss of the ogres an' goblins.
So leave anything to do with Ogre Bay to me."{w}{p}"So anyway, here's the thing. We're thinkin' of buildin' a
huge custom cannon... an' givin' the Palace of the Sun
a big 'KA-BOOOOM!'"{w}{p}"Then we can knock the Palace of the Sun right outta the sky, right?{w}Once it comes down to the ground, we can pound
the Kin of Darkness flat, no sweat."{w}{p}"...See, good plan, right?{w}And yet the rest of 'em, they just..."{w}{p}"You lot'll help us out, won'tcha!
Let's build a cannon together!!"{w}

"Please! I'm beggin' you here!!
Find my old man's blueprints for me!!"{w}
"Y-you got my old man's blueprints? ...Not yet, huh.{w}Aw, man, you got my hopes up for nothin'. Next time, come back once you've found 'em!!"{w}
You showed "Old Man's Plans" to Fulgrant.{w}
"Wh... Whoa!!! This is..."{w}{p}"It's my old man's blueprints, the ones I lost! No doubt about it!!{w}You really went and found 'em for me..."{w}

"Amazin'... You actually found 'em!!{w}Right, with these, that cannon's gettin' finished for sure! ...So, uh, about that..."{w}{p}"To build a cannon, see... you need tools. You get that, right?{w}Well, I went and lost the cannon tools too."{w}{p}"I can't build it like this! You lot... go find me those tools!!"{w}{p}"It's all so we can get at the Palace of the Sun. If you could find the blueprints, the tools'll be a snap for you, right? I'm countin' on you!"{w}
"Haah, them cannon tools just ain't turnin' up anywhere...{w}What, you lot ain't found 'em yet either?"{w}{p}"We'll keep lookin' too, but you lot keep at it as well!!"{w}
"Wha... Is that...!?{w}Those are the cannon tools, ain't they!!! You did it, you lot! Knew you had it in ya..."{w}{p}"Now we can build the cannon! Just you wait, my dear Kin of Darkness..."{w}

"...So, anyway. I've been thinkin'.{w}Once the cannon's done, we fire it into the Palace of the Sun -- 'KA-BOOOOM!' -- right?"{w}{p}"And when that happens, just standin' around watchin' would be pretty boring, don'tcha think?"{w}

"'Course you do! So what we're plannin' is, when we shoot down the Palace of the Sun, we all go 'WOOOOO!' and party it up!!"{w}{p}"And for that, we need bar snacks, right!{w}The plan is, everybody munches away while we whoop it up! And of course, the more folks watchin', the better!"{w}{p}"We'll invite a whole crowd... and then, if we watch it while munchin' on Seasoned Snacks..."{w}{p}"It's gonna be a blast, no question! You lot wanna eat some too, right?"{w}{p}"...Right, it's settled! We need Seasoned Snacks. I'm countin' on you! Go find some!"{w}
"So, find any Seasoned Snacks?{w}Hurry up and find 'em!! You wanna see the Palace of the Sun come down soon, don'tcha?"{w}

"Listen up, boys! It won't be long now...!
Let's show 'em what we're made of!!"{w}

"Yeah, this is it...!!
Seasoned Snacks, the real deal!!!{w}You did great findin' 'em!!"{w}
"Alllright, we'll get right to work on the preparations!{w}Once you lot are ready too, come talk to me! It won't be long now!!"{w}

"Yo, here's how things stand on our end.
You lot ready?"{w}
"What, you ain't ready yet...?"{w}{p}"Well, there's still time. Get yourselves good and ready, then come talk to me again!"{w}

"We're all set over here.
Well then, let's go fire this thing!"{w}

"Right! Let's get straight to it... You lot!!!
Here we go -- 'KA-BOOOOM!'!!!"{w}
"That's 'cause you handle it so rough, Lord Fulgrant~"{w}
"Sorry 'bout this. Looks like the repairs are gonna take a while..."{w}
"That's 'cause you handle it so rough, Lord Fulgrant~"{w}
"Sorry 'bout this. Looks like the repairs are gonna take a while..."{w}

"We're all set over here.
Well then, let's go fire this thing!"{w}
As if answering Fulgrant's voice, the ogres and goblins living in Ogre Bay gathered in one spot in no time at all.{w}

"Well? Ain't it a beauty?
I built that bit over there, y'know."{w}

"Like hell you did.
I built that!"{w}

"Oho, goin' at it, huh.
Bein' lively's fine, but keep that up and you'll miss the big moment when the cannon fires, y'know?"{w}

"Guess you got a point...
H-hey! It's about to start!"{w}

"Right! Let's get straight to it... You lot!!!
Here we go -- 'KA-BOOOOM!'!!!"{w}
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!{w}A thunderous roar rang out all around, shaking the air.{w}
The cannon scored a direct hit on the Palace of the Sun!{w}...It did, but the palace didn't budge an inch.{w}{p}Nothing was any different from before the cannon fired.{w}
After thinking for a moment, Fulgrant stared hard at you, as if struck by an idea.{w}You got a bad feeling about this.{w}

Before you knew it, Fulgrant had grabbed you and forcibly crammed you into the cannon.
From inside the cannon, you could see the sky.{w}

"How was it, you lot?
How'd it feel bein' a cannonball?"{w}

"You lot did good.
See? You made it back just fine, didn't ya!!"{w}{p}"Look, everybody's gathered here to catch a glimpse of you lot, y'know?"{w}
Everyone appeared in the hall, and you received their praise.{w}

"So I hear you got shot all the way to the Palace of the Sun with that cannon?{w}That must've been rough, huh?"{w}{p}"Still, you did great!
Congratulations!"{w}

"Lord Fulgrant's cannon truly is in a league of its own, isn't it.{w}To think it reached all the way to the Palace of the Sun..."{w}{p}"Thank you for all your hard work.
And congratulations."{w}

As a reward, you received
1,000,000 GP.{w}
"Hey, Balgert was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
"Hey, Rianna was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
"Hey, that brat from Perpeco was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
"The presence of darkness grows thicker still..."{w}{p}"Mayer, can you truly free and save Rafa?"{w}
"Of course. Once all is done, I will take you all to whatever land you desire, as promised."{w}

"......"{w}{p}"Rafa, wait for me...
I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}

"My, how desperate.
It's enough to make me cry... Ahahaha!"{w}
"That Moonlight Spirit seems to have room in her head for nothing but her own goals."{w}

"All the better for us...
Let her dance to our tune while she can."{w}
"Well, I never thought it would come to this!"{w}{p}"It's all because of that swindler, that Zaalhaut or whatever...{w}That wretch...!!"{w}
"She did a great deal for us."{w}
"But your body, Rafa, it keeps getting more and more...!"{w}
"You're so kind, Rafa, that everyone takes advantage and deceives you."{w}{p}"They use you however they please...{w}Poor, poor Rafa."{w}
"It's all right. I'll save you, okay?{w}I'll set you free from all that pain, okay?"{w}
"Shaharon and the others are going to separate you from the True Crystal, Rafa."{w}{p}"Until then, I won't let anyone into this Chamber of the True Sun."{w}
"Yorfa! That's enough!{w}I'm doing this of my own free will!"{w}
"It's all right, Rafa.{w}I'll protect you.{w}I'll save you, I swear."{w}
"...So now... even my words can't reach you...{w}Yorfa..."{w}
"Don't touch me!{w}You're out of your mind right now!"{w}
"Why?{w}Why would you say something like that?"{w}
"Yorfa! Please, go back to who you used to be!"{w}{p}"We watched over the land together in Nertowa, didn't we!"{w}{p}"Be the way you were back then! I'm begging you!!"{w}

"It's all right, we can go back."{w}{p}"Once I set you free, you and I will be just like before.
Like old times... together forever..."{w}{p}"Nothing else matters..."{w}
"Listen, Rafa..."{w}{p}"I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}{p}"If it means losing you..."{w}
"...then let the land be swallowed by darkness."{w}
"Why...{w}Why do you keep getting in my way?"{w}
In the Chamber of the True Sun, at the very heart of the Palace of the Sun, was the Moonlight Spirit, Yorfa.{w}
"Beyond here... is where Rafa is, you know.{w}Yes, my very own Rafa.{w}Mine, and mine alone..."{w}
Yorfa went on, wearing a look of rapture.{w}
"Would you all please step back?{w}I'm begging you, don't get in my way."{w}{p}"I'll ask you once more.{w}Would you please step back, adventurers?"{w}
"...I see. Then it can't be helped."{w}
Little by little, Yorfa began to change.{w}
"Why?{w}Why won't you just leave me be?"{w}
Tears poured endlessly from Yorfa's eyes.{w}
"I just... I just...{w}I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}
"I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.
You fled from the Floor Master.

"Wait, I haven't introduced everyone yet.{w}This is Mig.{w}A unicorn, as you can see."{w}{p}"Mig and I have been together since birth,{w}and Mig travels with me like this.{w}And..........."{w}
"Yamuru. I'm a bounty hunter.{w}I hear the Proclamation pays a pretty good sum,{w}so they've let me join this party."{w}
"My name is Korbitz.{w}We may end up relying on each other from here on,{w}so let's look out for one another, eh?"{w}
"The name's Mokero, it is!{w}The Miss has done a whole heap for me,{w}and I'll be followin' the Miss for the rest o' my days!"{w}

"Mokero, I keep telling you,
you don't have to be so formal..."{w}
"Miss! Don't go sayin' such cold things!{w}The debt I owe you, Miss, is............"{w}
"Electra's a kind child, you see,{w}and took us in, just like this.{w}So please, all of you, be good to Electra."{w}
"Ugh, honestly! You're all exaggerating!{w}If someone's in trouble, I help them.{w}
"Okay, okay, I get it!{w}Anyway, that's how it is, so be nice to all of us, okay?"{w}

"By the way... yours looks
like a pretty decent party."{w}

"We might end up competing with each other in all kinds of ways.{w}What do you say? How about you lot
and us have a little test of skill?"{w}
"These are the people who'll be our rivals from here on.{w}We need to see what they can do now, don't we?"{w}
"Besides, you need the bounty money, right?{w}Or was this something you started half-heartedly?"{w}

"Electra, what'll we do?
If you're going to fight, I'll help, okay?"{w}
"............Okay, I've made up my mind!"{w}{p}"You guys, let's have a match!{w}All right, everyone, let's go!!"{w}
"Ooh~ I'm gonna lop off some heads~!"{w}
"Not bad at all.{w}Still, Electra,{w}your alchemy spells are as half-baked as ever."{w}

"It's okay, Electra!
Your alchemy spells will get better from here on!"{w}
"It's all right,{w}there's no need to rush."{w}
"I'll be lendin' a hand too, I will!"{w}
"Everyone... thank you.{w}Okay, so that's how it is,{w}next time I'll be able to do a lot more!"{w}{p}"See you!"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
"Look, alchemy spells and Rangers go well together.{w}But if your success rate's low, it's pointless."{w}
"I know that already!{w}That's why I'm studying like this, okay!?"{w}
"Don't be so hard on the Miss!{w}I'll be pitchin' in too, I will!"{w}
"That's right, Electra!{w}You can't go through life bending your convictions!{w}You can still do it! Hang in there!"{w}
"You're right... I'll try a little harder!"{w}
"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{w}

Oh?"{w}
"Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{w}

How's it going? Things are going great for us!"{w}
"Come to think of it, you got the better of us last time.{w}It won't go that way this time, got it?"{w}
"Yamuru, you're more hot-blooded than you look.{w}Didn't you have a rule about never doing anything that doesn't pay?"{w}
"I'll be showin' what I'm made of too!"{w}

{0E}"Hm? Fine by me, but...{0F}
Okay, everyone, let's go!"{w}

{0E}"No, it's nothing.{0F}
You lot look like a pretty good party."{w}

"Well, it's parties like ours, with a unicorn,
that are the rare ones, y'know."{w}
"Having me around is proof of Innocence, after all!"{w}

{0E}"You're right.{0F}

"But I really do need to study...{w}Even you can read and write, right, Yamuru?"{w}

"That's a harsh way to put it.
What good is a bounty hunter who can't read a wanted poster?"{w}

"I can't read, but
